items.what: Gaussian-splat capture for at least one listed library, in data/splats.json
items.blocker: No splat capture with an open licence, a named author and an anonymous download found for any listed library. Searched 2026-11-12: Hugging Face datasets and models, Sketchfab API (about 33 name variants), SuperSplat by web search, GitHub, Wikimedia Commons, CULTURE3D, web search by library name. Not searchable without a login or past a bot check, so not proven empty: Zenodo API (403), SuperSplat API (401), Polycam, Luma, Kiri, OpenHeritage3D, Europeana. Nearest misses: State Library Victoria GLB meshes on Zenodo (CC BY-NC-SA) and a Sketchfab Library of Celsus photogrammetry mesh are meshes, not splats; a Sketchfab Morgan Library model needs a login. Way through: capture one, or train a splat from a licensed photo set.
